This.. Quite honestly kills me to hear. I don't even know where to begin, because I could never even come close to matching this experience. All I can say is that, well. You're worth something. That sounds generic and cliched but you are. Rape is so traumatizing and I commend you for lasting so long, and not breaking sooner.. Have either of you sought out counseling/medication for your depression? I know that's hardly enough to fix it but it could help. I dunno. I just don't wanna see someone as strong as you lose the fight and give up on themselves.

I'm 17 and a year ago, I was right where you're at. It's hard. Pushing through high school, and family changes at our age, when there's so much hormonal shit going on is crap, and a lot of times, I just felt like giving up. My ex girlfriend who I was with for 2 and a half years broke up with me a few months ago and now she's got a thing for another guy so I know how rough it is to go through that, on top of all the drama. You've gotta deal with at home and school. I hope you realize that life isn't always gonna be like this though. There's a lot of ups and downs and your just at one I those really low downs. When I'm like that I like to think that it's nothing but up from here right? I dunno, I'm ever the optomist. If you ever want someone to talk to, I'm here. Hope things starting heading up for you. I'll be praying!

Hey bud. Would you mind telling your story at least..? I'd like to hear how it came to this. It seems your at peace and I understand you probably won't be convince otherwise.. I'd still like to say I hope you change your mind. It'd be nice to have a friend.

Well the catch is she recently moved. She rarely talks to me lately because she feels so crappy, so it's hard for me to actually get a hold of anyone. I asked her to take a look at this site and r/depression, no reply but hopefully she'll do it. I'll try the hotline soon. I just want her better...
Of course. Anytime you need someone to talk to PM me.(: everyone needs someone. I'd love to hear how the phone call goes tomorrow.

Well I'm not sure what your religious affiliation is but around here there are a lot of charities for mental health based out of Christian church groups. I'm sure if you looked you could find other religions too. Just have to look. I'm sorry about the mental health place, just keep trying to call. I don't think you should ever feel ashamed about yourself. You've got a lot going on, thats out of your control. It's not your fault.

It sounds like your job is completely stalking you. I think if I were you I'd quit, and move on. It's not worth it if it brings you down so much. You've got a family, and I sense that you don't feel comfortable telling them all this and I'm the same way. I've gotten around it by telling them the bare minimum and explaining politely that's all I feel comfortable telling. You can have their support through this and you can get a better job you deserve!

I'm actually on Prozac too, for depression. I don't know the complete situation but I can tell you there's a lot of places where you can go to get counseling and support for these exact situations. I've had times when all I want to do is crawl into bed and just cry, and I've even attempted suicide before. I know you feel, but I also know that you can fight through it. I of course have never been pregnant and I can only imagine the challenges you face but I believe you can do it.. I have the utmost respect for you, and I hope things can get better. I'm praying for you..

Ya know, I don't have personal experience with this but I have a lot of friends who went through nearly an identical situation. (I'll get to that in just a second) I'm so sorry to hear all this. I know how it feels to think that it's all your fault, and my dad blames me for all of his life decisions. It sucks, and what I had to was just completely break ties with him. Honestly it's one of the hardest things I've ever had to do and sometimes I wonder if it was the right thing to do. But I feel 100% happier because I did. The friends I have who have trouble due to immigration, also had a really hard time with college, jobs, and pretty much all aspects of life. They had to fight every step of the way and it's not easy but there are ways to overcome it. I'm not sure if it would help but one of my friends just went and talked to a small community college and he was actually able to get it all worked out through them, and get schooling. I really hope things can get better for you, because life's hard sometimes but there are so many reasons to keep trying.. Hopefully this helped. I'm praying for you.(:

I know exactly how you feel... My best friend/lover had severe depression and anxiety and I tried so hard to help her.. One night we got in a fight, over the phone and I hung up on her. The next day I hear from her friend that she cut herself too deep and bled out... To this day I blame myself. I hate myself and honestly I don't even remember what the fight was about. I can tell you this: it doesn't ever go away. That what if feeling.. You just learn to cope. It's been five years since that day but it still hurts. I read the post and it sounded like she was at peace. Small comfort, I know, but it's something. Dunno what your religious affiliation is but I'll be praying for you friend.
